_comment: Terrain for local maps. walk = can be walked on; see = light passes through; cost = time multiplier to cross (1 = normal). tags drive game logic (water, tree, wall, door...).

tall_grass.name: tall grass
tall_grass.desc: Knee-high grass, wet with dew and ticks.

heather.name: heather
heather.desc: Tough heather and bilberry, catching at the ankles.

leaf_litter.name: leaf litter
leaf_litter.desc: Rotting leaves, soft and damp underfoot.

needles.name: pine needles
needles.desc: A thick, springy mat of old pine needles.

dry_earth.name: cracked earth
dry_earth.desc: Earth baked hard and cracked like old pottery.

mud.name: mud
mud.desc: Deep, clinging mud that pulls at your boots.

snow.name: snow
snow.desc: Snow, crusted and knee-deep in places.

frozen_ground.name: frozen ground
frozen_ground.desc: Earth frozen hard as iron, rimed with frost.

marsh_reeds.name: reeds
marsh_reeds.desc: Tall reeds standing in black water.

deep_water.name: deep water
deep_water.desc: Deep water. Too deep to wade; you would have to swim.

river.name: river
river.desc: Fast, cold river water. Too deep and strong to wade.

ford.name: ford
ford.desc: A shallow crossing where the river runs over stones. You will get wet.

bridge.name: bridge
bridge.desc: A rough bridge of timber and stone.

road.name: road
road.desc: A rutted cart road, muddy in the hollows.

tree_broadleaf.name: tree
tree_broadleaf.desc: An oak or ash, old and broad.

tree_pine.name: pine
tree_pine.desc: A tall pine, sticky with resin.

dead_tree.name: dead tree
dead_tree.desc: A dead tree, grey and leafless.

bush.name: bush
bush.desc: Thorny scrub. You can push through, slowly.

ruin_wall.name: ruined wall
ruin_wall.desc: The broken stump of an old wall, moss in every crack.

wall_wood.name: timber wall
wall_wood.desc: A wall of timber and wattle, daubed with mud.

floor_earth.name: beaten earth floor
floor_earth.desc: A floor of beaten earth, strewn with old straw.

crops.name: crops
crops.desc: A strip field of barley and oats.

garden.name: vegetable plot
garden.desc: Rows of cabbages, leeks and beans.

well.name: well
well.desc: A stone well with a bucket on a rope. The water is clean.

hearth.name: hearth
hearth.desc: A hearth, smoke-blackened, with a banked fire.

campfire.name: campfire
campfire.desc: A campfire, burning low, with the kettle beside it.

bed.name: bed
bed.desc: A straw pallet on a low frame. It smells of other people.

altar.name: altar
altar.desc: A stone altar, worn smooth by hands.

anvil.name: anvil
anvil.desc: A blacksmith's anvil on an oak stump.

stairs_down.name: stairs down
stairs_down.desc: Steps going down into the dark.

stairs_up.name: stairs up
stairs_up.desc: Steps going up, towards air and light.

door_locked.name: locked door
door_locked.desc: A heavy door, locked. Pick the lock (thieves' tools) or force it.

chest.name: chest
chest.desc: An iron-bound chest. Walk into it to open it.

chest_open.name: open chest
chest_open.desc: An empty chest, its lid thrown back.

sarcophagus.name: sarcophagus
sarcophagus.desc: A stone coffin with a carved lid. Walk into it to open it (the dead may not thank you).

captive.name: a captive
captive.desc: Someone chained to the wall, alive. Walk into them to break the chains.

chains.name: chains
chains.desc: Empty chains, hanging from a ring in the wall.

hoard.name: a dragon's hoard
hoard.desc: Gold, silver, gems and the armour of dead heroes, heaped up and slept on.

notice_board.name: notice board
notice_board.desc: A board of weathered planks, stuck with notices. Walk into it to read them.

stall.name: market stall
stall.desc: A trestle stall under a patched awning.

grave.name: grave
grave.desc: A grave marker, the name worn away.

barrels.name: barrels
barrels.desc: Barrels against the wall: ale, salt fish, rainwater.

crates.name: crates
crates.desc: Crates, nailed shut and stencilled with a merchant's mark.

woodpile.name: woodpile
woodpile.desc: Split logs stacked under a scrap of roof, for the winter.

haystack.name: haystack
haystack.desc: A stack of hay, a little damp on the north side.

cart.name: handcart
cart.desc: A handcart with a load roped down under a cloth.

trough.name: water trough
trough.desc: A trough of water for the animals. Not for drinking, if you can help it.

planter.name: flower box
planter.desc: A box of flowers someone takes care of.

sacks.name: sacks
sacks.desc: Sacks of grain, waiting for the mill or the market.

dry_grass.name: dry grass
dry_grass.desc: Dry grass, bleached by the sun, knee-high.

feather_grass.name: feather grass
feather_grass.desc: Feather grass, silver plumes nodding in the wind.

red_rock.name: red rock
red_rock.desc: Bare red sandstone, hot to the touch.

salt_crust.name: salt crust
salt_crust.desc: A white crust of salt, cracked into plates.

dune.name: dune crest
dune.desc: The steep crest of a dune: the sand slides away under each step.

ash.name: ash
ash.desc: Grey volcanic ash, soft as flour, that rises at every step.

lava.name: lava
lava.desc: Molten rock, glowing and slow. Do not.

fumarole.name: steam vent
fumarole.desc: A crack in the rock breathing scalding steam and sulphur.

crevasse.name: crevasse
crevasse.desc: A crack in the ice, blue and then black, with no bottom you can see.

cactus.name: cactus
cactus.desc: A cactus, ribbed and spined. There is water in it, if you are desperate.

termite_mound.name: termite hill
termite_mound.desc: A tower of red earth taller than a man, built by termites.

glowcaps.name: glowing mushrooms
glowcaps.desc: Mushrooms that give off a soft cold light.

tree_acacia.name: thorn tree
tree_acacia.desc: An acacia, flat-topped and thorny, its shade a blessing.

tree_jungle.name: jungle tree
tree_jungle.desc: A jungle giant, its trunk buttressed like a cathedral and roped with lianas.

tree_palm.name: palm
tree_palm.desc: A palm, its fronds rattling in the wind, dates hanging under them.

tree_fey.name: silver tree
tree_fey.desc: A silver-barked tree whose hanging leaves glow faintly, like a lamp turned low.

tree_stone.name: stone tree
tree_stone.desc: A tree turned to stone, every ring of its bark still there, striped with colour.

cliff.name: cliff
cliff.desc: A sheer face of rock, far too steep to climb without ropes and a death wish.

cliff_red.name: red cliff
cliff_red.desc: A wall of banded red stone, sheer as a fortress.

steep_path.name: steep path
steep_path.desc: A path cut in zigzags down the rock, a hand's width from a long fall.

falls.name: falling water
falls.desc: A river falling. Step into it and it will take you down with it.

plunge_pool.name: plunge pool
plunge_pool.desc: Churning white water at the foot of the falls, loud enough to drown a shout.

brine.name: brine
brine.desc: A shallow pool of water so salt it stings the eyes. Not for drinking.

glow_water.name: shining water
glow_water.desc: Deep water that glows from below, a cold blue-green.

glow_shallow.name: shining shallows
glow_shallow.desc: Shallow water lit from beneath; your feet in it look like a drowned man's.

sinter.name: sinter
sinter.desc: White and cream stone laid down by the springs, in terraces like frozen waves.

hot_spring.name: hot spring
hot_spring.desc: A pool of steaming water, as hot as a bath, milky blue and smelling of eggs.

geyser.name: geyser
geyser.desc: A cone of white stone that roars and throws scalding water at the sky every hour or so.

moonstone.name: standing stone
moonstone.desc: A pale standing stone in the middle of a ring of glowing mushrooms. It is warm to the touch.

root.name: great root
root.desc: A root as thick as a wall, which you climb over rather than step over.

giant_bark.name: great trunk
giant_bark.desc: The trunk of the great tree: bark in ridges deep enough to hide in, moss in every fold.

hollow_floor.name: hollow in the tree
hollow_floor.desc: The hollow heart of the great tree: dry, still, smelling of resin and centuries.

stone_arch.name: stone arch
stone_arch.desc: An arch of red stone carved by the wind, standing over nothing.

ledge.name: ledge
ledge.desc: A ledge of rock on the edge of the pit. Do not look down. You will look down.

chasm.name: the pit
chasm.desc: Nothing: a drop into darkness, and mist breathing up out of it.

wall_force.name: wall of force
wall_force.desc: A sheet of unseen force, faintly shimmering where the light catches it; nothing passes it.

wall_prismatic.name: prismatic wall
wall_prismatic.desc: Seven sheets of blazing colour, one behind another: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet.

ice_wall.name: wall of ice
ice_wall.desc: Old blue glacier ice, sheer and groaning, with shapes frozen deep inside it.

crater_rim.name: crater rim
crater_rim.desc: The broken lip of the crater, black rock and loose cinders.

cairn.name: summit cairn
cairn.desc: A cairn of stones on the top of the world, each one carried up by someone who made it.

drifting_stone.name: drifting stone
drifting_stone.desc: Overhead, a boulder the size of a cottage hangs in the air, turning slowly. Its shadow is cold.

wall_plaster.name: plastered wall
wall_plaster.desc: Wattle and daub between oak beams, plastered and limewashed.

wall_white.name: whitewashed wall
wall_white.desc: A thick wall, whitewashed so bright it hurts at noon.

wall_brick.name: brick wall
wall_brick.desc: Red brick, well laid, soot-stained at the top.

wall_sandstone.name: sandstone wall
wall_sandstone.desc: Blocks of honey-coloured sandstone, worn soft at the corners.

wall_marble.name: marble wall
wall_marble.desc: Dressed white marble, veined with grey.

wall_mudbrick.name: mud-brick wall
wall_mudbrick.desc: Sun-dried brick under a skin of mud plaster, cool inside even at noon.

wall_logs.name: log wall
wall_logs.desc: Whole logs, notched at the corners, the cracks stuffed with moss.

wall_felt.name: felt wall
wall_felt.desc: Thick felt over a lattice of willow, tied down with horsehair rope.

wall_earth.name: turf wall
wall_earth.desc: The grassy bank of a hill, dug into and lived in.

floor_tile.name: tiled floor
floor_tile.desc: Glazed tiles in a pattern of stars and knots.

rug_floor.name: rugs
rug_floor.desc: Rugs laid over rugs: red, indigo and saffron wool.

courtyard.name: courtyard
courtyard.desc: A paved court open to the sky, cool with shade and the sound of water.

flagstones.name: flagstones
flagstones.desc: Broad paving stones, worn smooth by feet.

packed_sand.name: packed earth
packed_sand.desc: Earth trodden hard as stone, sand drifted into its corners.

boardwalk.name: boardwalk
boardwalk.desc: Split logs laid across the mud, for the streets of a town that was once a bog.

causeway.name: white causeway
causeway.desc: A raised road of white stucco, straight as a rule.

earthwork.name: earth bank
earthwork.desc: A bank of earth and turf twice a man's height, with stakes along its top.

low_wall.name: low wall
low_wall.desc: A wall waist-high, easy to see over, not to walk through.

hedge.name: hedge
hedge.desc: A thick hedge of hawthorn and holly, neatly kept.

thorn_hedge.name: thorn hedge
thorn_hedge.desc: A hedge of thorns grown into a wall, the spines as long as fingers.

pyramid.name: pyramid
pyramid.desc: The flank of the great pyramid, stepped stone faced with painted plaster.

pyramid_steps.name: pyramid steps
pyramid_steps.desc: Steep steps up the pyramid's face, each as high as your knee.

chair.name: chair
chair.desc: A chair with a straight back.

bench.name: bench
bench.desc: A long bench, polished by sitting.

counter.name: counter
counter.desc: A long counter, scarred by coins and elbows.

shelf.name: shelves
shelf.desc: Shelves of jars, pots and boxes.

bookcase.name: bookcase
bookcase.desc: Shelves of books, bound in leather and board, some chained.

wardrobe.name: wardrobe
wardrobe.desc: A tall cupboard of dark wood.

trunk.name: trunk
trunk.desc: A trunk bound in iron, locked, and not yours.

rug.name: rug
rug.desc: A woven rug, its pattern worn by feet.

oven.name: oven
oven.desc: A domed oven of clay and brick, warm to the touch.

pew.name: pew
pew.desc: A row of wooden seats facing the altar.

candles.name: candles
candles.desc: Candles in a stand, their light steady in the still air.

statue_small.name: statue
statue_small.desc: A carved figure on a plinth: a saint, a king or a god.

statue.name: statue
statue.desc: A statue on a high plinth, its face worn by the weather.

forge.name: forge
forge.desc: A smith's forge, its coals glowing under the bellows.

coal.name: coal heap
coal.desc: A heap of charcoal, and black dust all round it.

herbs.name: drying herbs
herbs.desc: Bunches of herbs hung to dry, filling the room with their smell.

throne.name: high seat
throne.desc: The high seat of the hall, carved and gilded, with a cushion worn flat.

banner.name: banner
banner.desc: A banner on a pole, the arms of those who rule here.

tapestry.name: tapestry
tapestry.desc: A tapestry of a hunt, a battle, a wedding: the house remembering itself.

weapon_rack.name: weapon rack
weapon_rack.desc: Spears, axes and swords in a rack, oiled and ready.

armour_stand.name: armour stand
armour_stand.desc: A suit of mail on a wooden frame, like a man with no one inside.

lectern.name: lectern
lectern.desc: A lectern with a great book chained to it, open.

cauldron.name: cauldron
cauldron.desc: A great cauldron over a fire, something bubbling in it.

bath_water.name: bath
bath_water.desc: A deep bath of warm water, steaming.

boat.name: boat
boat.desc: A boat up on trestles, half-mended.

fish_rack.name: drying rack
fish_rack.desc: Fish split and hung on racks to dry in the wind.

mushrooms.name: mushroom bed
mushrooms.desc: A bed of dark earth growing pale mushrooms in rows.

tomb_slab.name: tomb
tomb_slab.desc: A stone tomb, its lid carved with the likeness of the one inside.

brazier.name: brazier
brazier.desc: An iron brazier on legs, full of glowing coals.

lamp_post.name: lamp post
lamp_post.desc: A lamp on an iron post, lit at dusk by the lamplighter.

lantern_post.name: lantern
lantern_post.desc: A lantern hung on a carved post, glowing softly.

torch_post.name: torch
torch_post.desc: A pitch torch on a pole, flaring in the wind.

fire_pit.name: fire pit
fire_pit.desc: A ring of stones round a fire that is never let go out.

fountain.name: fountain
fountain.desc: A stone fountain, water falling from a carved mouth into a basin.

palm_pot.name: palm
palm_pot.desc: A palm in a great clay pot.

rug_stall.name: rug stall
rug_stall.desc: A stall hung with rugs, the trader crosslegged among them.

standing_stone.name: standing stone
standing_stone.desc: A tall stone set up before anyone can remember, lichened and leaning.

runestone.name: runestone
runestone.desc: A stone carved with a serpent and runes, painted red: someone's grief or pride.

peat_stack.name: peat stack
peat_stack.desc: Turves of peat stacked to dry, for the winter fires.

stela.name: stela
stela.desc: A carved stone pillar: a lord in a feathered headdress, and the day of his reign.

altar_stone.name: altar stone
altar_stone.desc: A low stone with a groove in it, stained dark.

maize_crib.name: granary
maize_crib.desc: A crib of poles full of maize cobs, raised off the ground.

amphora.name: amphorae
amphora.desc: Tall jars of oil and wine, propped in a rack.

olive_tree.name: olive tree
olive_tree.desc: An olive tree, silver-leaved and twisted, older than the street.

tree_cypress.name: cypress
tree_cypress.desc: A dark cypress, tall and narrow as a flame.

tree_birch.name: birch
tree_birch.desc: A white birch, its bark peeling like paper.

party_tree.name: great tree
party_tree.desc: A huge old tree at the heart of the place, a ring of benches round its roots.

standard.name: standard
standard.desc: A spear-shaft hung with horsetails: the standard of the clan.

horse_post.name: hitching post
horse_post.desc: A post with a ring, for tying horses.

sledge.name: sledge
sledge.desc: A sledge on its runners, waiting for snow.

bell_post.name: bell
bell_post.desc: A bell hung in a little wooden frame, for fire and for feasts.

mine_cart.name: ore cart
mine_cart.desc: A cart of ore on its rails.

beehive.name: beehives
beehive.desc: Straw skeps full of bees, busy and loud.

skull_post.name: skull post
skull_post.desc: A stake with a skull on it, and other skulls at its foot.
